svg.title: Read the pedigree before assigning a genotype
svg.desc: Generation I contains unfilled male I-1 and unfilled female I-2 connected as reproductive partners. Their generation II children are filled male II-1, unfilled female II-2 and unfilled male II-3. The explicit simplified legend defines square as male, circle as female, filled as the tracked phenotype present and unfilled as absent; no carrier measurements are shown. Under a fully penetrant autosomal recessive model with accurate relationships and no new mutation, parents are Aa, the filled child aa, and each unfilled child AA or Aa. For either known-unaffected sibling the conditional carrier probability is2/3. This is a fictional teaching family, not a request for personal family disclosure or proof that the recessive model is uniquely correct.

g.text: Read the pedigree before assigning a genotype
An original fictional family keeps recorded phenotypes separate from model-based inference.
Fictional observations; filled = scored phenotype present.
Legend: square = male, circle = female in this simplified recorded pedigree.
Unfilled = scored phenotype absent; no genotype or confirmed-carrier marks are recorded.
Under a fully penetrant autosomal recessive model with accurate records and no new mutation:
I-1 and I-2 must be Aa; II-1 is aa. II-2 and II-3 can each be AA or Aa.
Each unaffected sibling has P(carrier | unaffected) = ⅔ under this model.
